source.quote: Hegel's own page for the H150, read 2026-11-24. « Digital inputs »: « 1x Coaxial (RCA) S/PDIF - 24/192, 2x Optical S/PDIF - 24/96, 1x USB B- 24/192, 1x USB A 2.0 - USB Drives (10,000 songs), 1x Network - 24/192 ». « Digital outputs »: « 1x Coaxial S/PDIF - 24/192 ». No DSD figure anywhere. The prose says « a competent, custom-designed, four-layered digital-to-analog converter (DAC) ». No DAC chip is named anywhere on the page, and no digital filter, oversampling or NOS row exists.

facts.chip: Not named. « a competent, custom-designed, four-layered digital-to-analog converter » - « four-layered » describes the circuit board, not the conversion.
